description: This file provides helper extension methods for the CanvasWindowController class, including functions for sanitizing session keys, creating JS string literals, and storing/loading window frame data.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: An extension to CanvasWindowController providing helper static methods for session key management, JSON encoding, and window frame persistence.

methods.name: sanitizeSessionKey
methods.description: Sanitizes a session key by trimming whitespace and replacing disallowed characters with underscores.

methods.name: jsStringLiteral
methods.description: Encodes a string as a JSON string literal, escaping characters as needed.

methods.name: jsOptionalStringLiteral
methods.description: Returns a JSON string literal for a string optional, or 'null' if nil.

methods.name: storedFrameDefaultsKey
methods.description: Generates a key string for storing window frame data associated with a session key.

methods.name: loadRestoredFrame
methods.description: Loads and returns an NSRect from UserDefaults if valid, returning nil otherwise.

methods.name: storeRestoredFrame
methods.description: Stores the NSRect frame in UserDefaults associated with a session key.
